summary.convention: rbx: x = character right, y up; hand_lateral = wrist x minus shoulder x (+ = to the right, world); yaw + = turned to the character's left; roll + = right side up; shoulder_swing + = forward

qa.lowest_point_note: lowest_body_point is the lowest box corner; on bent rear legs it is the shin box's ankle-end back corner under the heel (R15 block artifact, below the floor plane). Knees: knee_min_height_studs.
